name: Tic-Tac-Toe
tagline: The computer plays here, perfectly. A friend from one link. No game server.
description:
The computer thinks on this phone, and it does not lose. There is no game server. Press Play a friend, send the invite, and they sit the other mark on the same board.

A three-by-three grid. One of you is X, the other is O. Take turns putting a mark down. First to three in a line — across, down, or diagonal — wins. Close it and come back: the file is the save.

On your own you play a perfect computer, on this device. Pass the phone for two people in the same room, or send one link.

An unofficial port of Colyseus Tic-Tac-Toe. The original needs a game server. This copy does not.
